guidance: Crash-recovered Act3 floor37 MAP, HP91/93, gold141, Sai gives7 Block at every turn start, Pyre+ grants2 energy/turn when played, Barricade+ costs2 and retains Block, Juggling+ innate can copy a third attack. Liquid Bronze and Clarity potions remain; Shame can cause Frail if held at turn end. Only row4/col4 Monster is available (map option0); it leads to another Monster then a Rest Site and Treasure. In combat prioritize preventing HP loss, use Sai Block and retained Barricade Block, apply Weak with Uppercut+ against large attacks, and set Pyre+/Barricade+ up only when immediate incoming damage is safely covered. Use a potion if it averts meaningful damage or a lethal risk. On card rewards take clear defense/draw/scaling gains, avoid another marginal attack in the now larger deck. Stop at floor38 MAP, HP<=55 before energy use, terminal, or budget.
